distribution_ratio.value: one share of the Company’s Class A common stock, par value $0.01 per share (“Company Class A Common Stock”), for every two shares of MSG Knicks Class A Common Stock
distribution_ratio.quote: each holder of MSG Knicks Class A common stock, par value $0.01 per share (“MSG Knicks Class A Common Stock”), received one share of the Company’s Class A common stock, par value $0.01 per share (“Company Class A Common Stock”), for every two shares of MSG Knicks Class A Common Stock held of record as of the close of business, New York City time, on October 20, 2026 (the “Record Date”)

record_date.quote: as of the close of business, New York City time, on October 20, 2026 (the “Record Date”)

distribution_date.quote: On October 26, 2026, MSG Knickerbockers Corp. (formerly Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. and referred herein as “MSG Knicks”) effected the distribution (the “Distribution”) of all of the issued and outstanding shares of the common stock of MSG Rangers Corp.
